description: How fgOS recognises a skill directory it generated, and which skill names it owns. The render (src/setup/skill-wrappers.mjs, repository tooling) is the only writer; the Rust reader (packages/distribution/rust/src/skill_stamp.rs) and the render's own test (test/setup/skill-wrappers.test.mjs) read this file, so the stamp and the owned-name rule have one source of vectors. Vector trees are built under a fresh directory; expectations are relative to it, sorted.

stamps.rule: A stamp is the first line, after an optional leading frontmatter fence block (--- ... ---, either line ending) and leading white space, of a SKILL.md (wrapper: the line equals a wrapper stamp) or of any markdown file in the directory tree (assembled: the line starts with the header prefix). An .agents/skills directory is also ours when the same name under .claude/skills carries a wrapper stamp. A link, in a skills root or above it, is never walked.

owned.rule: A directory with a SKILL.md directly under a source root, not hidden (leading dot), not _shared and not a render temp name; domain directories are real directories, not hidden, not temp names. Links are not followed.
